source.test: ensureOK(_:_:), called by every downloadAndGo provider before parsing a response body

notes: The shared helper (ServerJarProviders.swift:580-584) any non-2xx-checking call site uses: `networkError("\(what) returned status \(code).")`, where `what` is a call-site-supplied label baked into the message ("Mojang manifest", "Paper builds for 1.21.11", etc. -- every call site names itself). Only a literal HTTP status code != 200 trips this; a 200 with a garbage body is a separate failure mode (see malformed-json-response-rejected-as-invalid-shape). NeoForge/Forge check status inline rather than through this shared helper (`if let http = resp as? HTTPURLResponse, http.statusCode != 200 { throw .network(...) }`) but produce the same class of error for the same condition.
